# Potato

> Potato is a free, open-source, self-hosted annotation and agent-evaluation
> platform for NLP, agentic, and GenAI research. Tasks are configured entirely in
> YAML (no coding) to annotate text, audio, video, images, documents, and AI agent
> traces. It also provides a full agent-evaluation loop — programmatic evaluators,
> versioned datasets and experiments, automation rules, CI gating, LLM-as-judge
> calibration, semantic curation, and a multi-model arena — as a free, self-hosted
> alternative to LangSmith, LabelBox, and Braintrust.

Website: https://www.potatoannotator.com · Docs: https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io ·
Code: https://github.com/davidjurgens/potato · Papers: Potato 2.0, ACL 2026 (System Demonstrations), https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-demo.37/ ·
Potato 1.0, EMNLP 2022 (System Demonstrations), https://aclanthology.org/2022.emnlp-demos.33/.

## Machine-readable specs

Generated from the running code, not maintained by hand. Prefer these over prose
when writing a config or calling the API.

- [Config JSON Schema](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/schemas/potato-config.schema.json): every valid config.yaml key, all 76 annotation types and 27 display types; validates a config before the server runs
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api-reference/openapi.json): all 512 HTTP paths, with auth (`x-potato-auth`) and config gating (`x-potato-requires-config`) per operation
- [Examples catalog](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/schemas/potato-examples.manifest.json): all 249 example projects, with the annotation types, display types and features each one demonstrates
- [How to use them](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api-reference/machine_readable/): editor setup, CI validation, jq recipes
- [MCP server](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tools/mcp_server/): `potato mcp serve` exposes the registries, the validator and a headless renderer as MCP tools
- [Agent instructions](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tools/authoring-agents/): the Claude Code skill and `AGENTS.md` for building a task, published separately at github.com/davidjurgens/potato-skill
- [Full documentation in one file](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/llms-full.txt): every page inlined (~3.0 MB)

## Start here

- [What is Potato / FAQ](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/faq/): direct answers to common questions
- [Glossary](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/glossary/): annotation & agent-evaluation terms defined
- [Quick Start](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/quick-start/): install and run in 5 minutes
- [Comparison with other tools](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/comparison/): Potato vs Label Studio, Prodigy, LangSmith, LabelBox

## Agent / agentic evaluation

- [Agent Evaluation Guide](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/agent-evaluation-guide/): evaluate agent trajectories, tool calls, and outputs
- [Programmatic Evaluators](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent-evaluation/evaluators/): trajectory match, tool-use, LLM-judge, heuristics
- [Datasets & Experiments](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent-evaluation/datasets_and_experiments/): versioned eval sets + experiment runs
- [Automation Rules](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent-evaluation/automation_rules/): route incoming traces to queues/datasets/evaluators
- [CI Evaluation](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent-evaluation/ci_evaluation/): gate CI on eval-score regressions (pytest)
- [LLM-as-Judge Alignment](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent-evaluation/judge_alignment/): measure & auto-calibrate judges against human gold
- [Model Arena](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agent-evaluation/model_arena/): compare N models side by side
- [Tracing SDK](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/integrations/tracing_sdk/): instrument agents with @traceable

## Behavioral experiments and surveys

- [Coming from jsPsych](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/coming-from-jspsych/): jsPsych concepts mapped to Potato config, and when to use which
- [Experiment Flow](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/workflow/experiment_flow/): between-subjects conditions, page branching (show_when), screen-outs (exit_when), counterbalancing, randomized question order
- [jsPsych Phase](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/workflow/jspsych_phase/): run a jsPsych 8 timeline as one page of a Potato study; data stored and exported per participant
- [Timed Trials](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/workflow/timed_trials/): fixation, stimulus duration, response deadline, key-to-label reaction times on annotation items
- [Sensitive Questions](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/measurement/sensitive_questions/): list experiments (item count technique) and randomized response (forced response, crosswise), estimated in the survey_experiments export
- [Vocabulary Tests](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/measurement/vocabulary_test/): LexTALE-style word/nonword decision, scored in the lextale export; item lists not bundled
- [Interlinear Glossed Text](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/text/interlinear_gloss/): word-by-word morpheme segmentation and Leipzig glosses with alignment checks; FLExText and Toolbox import/export, gb4e LaTeX export
- [Ego Networks](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/structured/ego_network/): name generators, interpreters, dyad census and a sociogram in one question; GraphML and density export; Network Canvas import
- [Free Lists and Triad Tests](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/cultural-domain-analysis/): free listing with salience (Smith's S), triad tests with balanced designs, pile sorts and cultural consensus analysis
- [Incentive Payments](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/advanced/incentives/): price lists (Holt-Laury, time preference), BDM bids and scored belief reports, with seeded payoff draws and a Prolific bonus file
- [Maps](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/spatial/geo_annotation/): points, lines and polygons on a map stored as GeoJSON; offline basemaps; draw-a-map heat maps for perceptual dialectology
- [Protein Structures](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/science/protein_structures/): residues selected in 3Dmol.js (vendored) or Mol* (potato vendor fetch); mmCIF, BinaryCIF, PDB; pLDDT and PAE
- [Genome Loci](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/science/genome_loci/): variant review in igv.js from local FASTA, BAM, VCF and BED over range requests; clicked calls stored by viewer_selection
- [Spectrogram Annotation](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/multimedia/spectrogram_annotation/): time-frequency boxes on audio; Raven, Audacity and BirdNET import and export
- [Camera Traps](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/camera-traps/): review MegaDetector and COCO Camera Traps output; export MegaDetector JSON, Camtrap DP and Darwin Core
- [Digital Humanities Formats](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/digital-humanities/): IIIF manifests in and out, W3C Web Annotation import, PAGE XML line correction, TEI P5
- [Content Analysis](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/content-analysis/): codebooks from a CSV (taxonomy_file) and Krippendorff's alpha per variable with bootstrap intervals
- [Coming from Ibex and PCIbex](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/coming-from-ibex/): import an Ibex or PCIbex experiment folder, with Latin-square lists
- [Self-Paced Reading and Maze](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/workflow/self_paced_reading/): moving-window, centred and cumulative self-paced reading and the (A-)maze task, with per-region reading times
- [Listening Tests](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/multimedia/listening_tests/): MUSHRA (ITU-R BS.1534), BS.1116, ACR/DCR/CCR (ITU-T P.800/P.808), P.835 and ABX, blinded, with MOS and post-screening export
- [Runtime Phases](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/workflow/runtime_phases/): jsPsych pages, the built-in headphone check (Huggins pitch, antiphase), and `external` tasks on another server (oTree, Empirica, hosted surveys) with a return link
- [Importing Surveys](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tools/survey_import/): Qualtrics .qsf, SurveyJS, LimeSurvey .lss, XLSForm (ODK/Kobo), REDCap data dictionaries, Beiwe and Network Canvas protocols (7 formats) as Potato survey pages with their display logic
- [Multi-Phase Workflows](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/workflow/surveyflow/): consent, screeners, instructions, training, post-study surveys
- [Survey Instruments](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/advanced/survey_instruments/): 55 validated questionnaires by name (TIPI, PHQ-9, GAD-7, ...)

## Annotation

- [Schema Gallery](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/schemas_and_templates/): all 76 annotation types
- [Configuration Reference](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configuration/config_reference/): every config option
- [Quality Control](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/workflow/quality_control/): IAA, gold standards, attention checks
- [Labeling Engine](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/labeling-engine/overview/): models label the dataset; a blind random human sample certifies which machine labels to accept, with stated error bounds and prevalence intervals
- [Working with Transcripts](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/working_with_transcripts/): annotate Whisper output and YouTube subtitles
- [Transcript Formats](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/multimedia/transcript_formats/): Whisper, WhisperX, SRT/VTT/ASS/TTML, YouTube captions, AWS/Deepgram/AssemblyAI/Rev.ai, CTM, TextGrid, EAF
- [Image Annotation Formats](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/annotation-types/multimedia/image_formats/): COCO import/export — polygons, uncompressed and compressed RLE, crowd regions, sparse category IDs, no preprocessing
- [Crowdsourcing](https://potatoannotator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/deployment/crowdsourcing/): nine crowd providers, including Prolific, MTurk, CloudResearch Connect, SONA, Microworkers and Clickworker
